author: p_ywsbww3c
title: Hotel Death
body:
ForBorne Cemetery & Mortuary Museum: 10 miles. 
 "Dad the sign said we are 10 miles out. Should I call ahead?" 
A single bead of sweat dripped from the silent passengers forehead. Emmet was not in the mood to talk. His son had insisted on this whole escapade. How was he suppose to see his sister off, when he couldn't see at all. Besides she had seen him off decades ago. 
Had it not been for his utter lack of excuses, he would not have gone at all.
"Look dad, Can you just try and keep an open mi-"
"Silas stop the car."
Emmet Sat up sharply. 
The Countryside had given way to rolling foothills. 
Silas sighed heavily. 
"Dad we are on a narrow 2 lane highway with no sides, I am not stopping."
Silas could have sworn he had put the child lock on the passengers door when he helped his father in. 
Apparently, he had not.
"Son one day your going to ask yourself why you bought this gay car" 
Emmet stared blindly at his son for a moment. Opening the passenger door and unclipping his seatbelt. Silas watched in horror as his dad climbed out the door and hurled himself on-top of the vehicle. 
"Jesus christ dad what in hell are you doing?" 
Emmets wrinkled grinning face sat directly above silas. He was unbeknownst to him facing the back seat. 
"Seeing my sister off Son! Is that not what we came here for"
